name: ai-compare
title: AI Compare
description: Search from Raycast and compare answers across multiple AI sites. Requires the AI Compare Chrome extension.

commands.name: search
commands.title: Search with AI Compare
commands.description: Send a Raycast query to AI Compare and compare answers across selected AI sites.

preferences.name: sites

preferences.name: siteType

preferences.title: OpenClaw Mode
preferences.description: Include openclaw=1 in the launch URL for automation/test runners.
